notes: No study identifier, outcome description or test locator was supplied. The primary replication report explicitly identifies original Study 1 Hypothesis 1, allowing the matched original test to be located. Both sources print regression coefficients b; these were retained instead of converting to the requested Cohen's f^2. Original PDF text extraction encodes minus signs as 2 and equality/inequality symbols as 5/comma; quotations above normalize those mathematical glyphs. The replication report notes a correction to the original printed scale anchors confirmed with the original first author. No author-derived f^2 was printed in the inspected target passages.
